description: This file contains classes and functions related to OAuth 1.0 authentication, including consumers, tokens, signature methods, requests, and data store interfaces, used to implement OAuth signing and request verification.

classes.name: OAuthException
classes.description: Custom exception class for OAuth errors.

classes.name: OAuthConsumer
classes.description: Represents an OAuth consumer with key and secret.

classes.name: OAuthToken
classes.description: Represents an OAuth token, including method to serialize to string.

classes.name: OAuthSignatureMethod
classes.description: Abstract base class for OAuth signature methods, defining required methods.

classes.name: OAuthSignatureMethod_RSA_SHA1
classes.description: Abstract class for RSA-SHA1 signature method, including fetch public/private cert methods.

classes.name: OAuthRequest
classes.description: Handles OAuth 1.0 request construction, signing, and parameter management.

classes.name: OAuthServer
classes.description: Implements an OAuth server for token handling and request verification.

classes.name: OAuthDataStore
classes.description: Interface for data storage backends needed for OAuth operations.

classes.name: OAuthUtil
classes.description: Provides utility functions for encoding, parameter parsing, header processing, and nonce/timestamp generation.

methods.name: get_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the signature method.

methods.name: build_signature
methods.description: Builds the signature for a request, implementation varies by method.

methods.name: check_signature
methods.description: Verifies if a signature is correct.

methods.name: to_url
methods.description: Constructs the URL with OAuth parameters.

methods.name: get_signature_base_string
methods.description: Retrieves the base string for signing.

methods.name: sign_request
methods.description: Signs a request with provided signature method, consumer, and token.
